title: LinkDesk icon theme mappings data contract
description: Contract for the mappings JSON file referenced by contributes.iconThemes — mirrors the engine's normalizeIconThemeMappings (src/pluginLoader/contributions/contributions.ts). Four mapping tables (files/extensions/folders/foldersExpanded) plus five top-level default icon keys (file/folder/folderExpanded/rootFolder/rootFolderExpanded); each entry takes one of two forms: a font glyph (class + optional color) or an image asset (imagePath, relative to the plugin root). An optional top-level font section declares a custom icon font. Validation: @linkdesk/plugin-sdk validateIconThemeJson on the npm side, check-theme-schema.mjs on the repo side (it scans every contributes.iconThemes entry).

$schema.description: Editor IntelliSense reference (optional) — npm authors reference node_modules/@linkdesk/plugin-sdk/schemas/icon-theme.schema.json

files.description: File name → icon entry (highest match priority; on a miss, extensions is consulted)

extensions.description: Extension (including the dot, e.g. ".ts"/".jsx") → icon entry

foldersExpanded.description: Folder name → icon entry (expanded; defaults to reusing folders)

file.description: Default file icon — used when files/extensions miss (default: the shell's fallback icon)

folder.description: Default folder icon — used when folders misses (default: the shell's fallback)

folderExpanded.description: Default expanded folder icon — used when foldersExpanded misses (default: the shell's fallback)

rootFolder.description: Root folder icon (default: the shell's fallback)

rootFolderExpanded.description: Expanded root folder icon (default: the shell's fallback)

font.description: Custom icon font (optional) — once declared, the shell generates @font-face and the author supplies the glyph classes

mappingTable.description: Mapping table — name (file name / extension / folder name) → icon entry

iconMapping.title: Icon entry — pick one of two forms

anyOf.title: Font glyph form
anyOf.description: CSS class name — codicon as the fallback, or a custom icon font (when class is omitted, the icon font family's own class is used)

class.description: CSS class name (e.g. "codicon codicon-typescript" or "myfont myfont-rust")

color.description: Optional per-icon color (for colorful seti-style fonts; omit for plain monochrome fonts)

anyOf.title: Image asset form
anyOf.description: Image asset — any multicolor, skeuomorphic, or textured artwork

imagePath.description: Path to the image asset relative to the plugin root (e.g. "icons/js.svg") — at render time the shell resolves it to an absolute linkdesk:// URL via getPluginAssetPath; absolute /assets/... paths are forbidden

fontSpec.description: Custom icon font metadata — path is relative to the plugin root or an absolute URL; the shell generates @font-face and the author writes the glyph class CSS

path.description: Font file path relative to the plugin root (or an absolute linkdesk:// / http(s):// / data: URL)

family.description: The family name the author writes in font-family in the glyph CSS

glyphs.description: Path to the glyph class CSS file relative to the plugin root (optional; default: @font-face only, no custom glyph classes)
